# Little Hero Labs

Little Hero Labs creates personalized children's picture books where each child becomes the hero of the story. The launch book is Finding Our Inner Voice, a gentle 16-page softcover for ages 0-7 with the strongest fit for ages 3-6.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://www.littleherolabs.com/
- Personalized children's books: https://www.littleherolabs.com/our-books
- How it works: https://www.littleherolabs.com/how-it-works
- Personalized birthday book: https://www.littleherolabs.com/personalized-birthday-book
- Personalized dinosaur book: https://www.littleherolabs.com/personalized-dinosaur-book
- Personalized unicorn book: https://www.littleherolabs.com/personalized-unicorn-book
- Children's books about courage: https://www.littleherolabs.com/childrens-books-about-courage
- Confidence book for kids: https://www.littleherolabs.com/confidence-book-for-kids

## Product Facts

- Product: Finding Our Inner Voice
- Format: launch edition 8.5 x 8.5 softcover, 16 pages
- Personalization: child name, appearance, hometown, dedication, pronouns, favorite color, and animal companion
- Current purchase path: Little Hero Labs site and Amazon Custom
- Support: hello@littleherolabs.com

## Crawl Notes

The `/create/` flow and tokenized approval previews are interactive customer surfaces, not reference content. Prefer the public marketing pages above for summaries and citations.
